modelNotes: Points Board 1.4 reads from core, minutes, usage, opponent team defense, and opponent pace data.
Opponent points defense and pace apply a transparent adjustment capped at plus or minus 6 percent.
Expected minutes, rest, verified teammate absences, and recent-game volatility produce opportunity adjustments and projection ranges.

Foundation uses scoring average, last 5 form, last 10 form, enhanced expected minutes, minutes confidence, minutes trend, usage score, usage trend, volume acceleration, shot volume trend, free throw volume trend, and starter status.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Doncic (back) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Pistons.
injury.detail: Doncic dropped his second 50-piece of the season during Friday's 124-118 win over Portland, but the Lakers' superstar is dealing with tightness in his lower back that will leave his status for Sunday's outing up in the air. If Doncic is unable to suit up, Austin Reaves will take over primary offensive responsibilities while Quentin Grimes and Collin Sexton would see a substantial increase in minutes for the first night of LA's back-to-back set.

injury.shortComment: Embiid (foot) is probable for Sunday's game against the Bulls.
injury.detail: Embiid continues to work through plantar fasciitis in his right foot. Philadelphia has kept their star center on an injury management routine, and with Embiid being listed as probable to suit up versus Chicago, he's likely to be active and reprise his starting role for the 8-2 76ers.

injury.shortComment: Markkanen is questionable for Sunday's game against the Timberwolves due to a right wrist sprain.
injury.detail: Markkanen initially injured his wrist Oct. 26 against the Grizzlies, and although he has played in four games since then, he may be at risk of sitting out Sunday's contest. Josh Green could get another look in the starting lineup if Markkanen is unable to play.

injury.shortComment: Smith (finger) is probable for Sunday's game against Philadelphia.
injury.detail: Smith left Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks after just seven minutes of play due to a left finger sprain and was initially deemed questionable for Sunday. His upgraded status is a good sign for Smith, who's been the starting center with Nic Claxton (hamstring) yet to play this season.

injury.shortComment: Beringer (nose) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Jazz.
injury.detail: Beringer broke his nose during Friday's win over the Pelicans, so he might need to miss Sunday's game. If he's out, Trey Lyles would have the chance for some extended run.

injury.shortComment: Awaka (knee) is questionable for Sundays' game against the 76ers.
injury.detail: Awaka missed Wednesday's 135-105 loss to the Knicks due to a sprained left MCL, and he's now in danger of missing a second consecutive outing with the ailment. Zach Collins (illness) has already been ruled out Sunday, leaving Noa Essengue, Leonard Miller and Patrick Williams as candidates to see more opportunities off Chicago's bench.

injury.shortComment: Jones posted 18 points (6-14 FG, 0-3 3Pt, 3-3 FT), 10 rebounds, an assist, two steals and two blocks in Wednesday's 100-88 Summer League loss to the Suns.
injury.detail: Jones was one of four Phoenix players who scored at least 15 points, and he also led the team in rebounds and blocks while ranking second in steals. This was Jones' second double-double in four Summer League contests, and the third time he has surpassed the 15-point threshold.

injury.shortComment: Harkless signed a two-way contract with the Pistons, Keith Smith of Spotrac.com reports.
injury.detail: Harkless is no longer a free agent after the Jazz declined his team option back in June. A defensive-minded wing, Harkless will likely play a prominent role for Detroit's G League affiliate in the early going.
